name: UpdateCustomObject
label: Update a custom object
description: Updates an existing custom object in Salesforce with new field values.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: The credential to connect with (JSON containing InstanceUrl, AccessToken, ApiVersion).

fields.name: CustomObjectNameOrId
fields.label: Custom Object API Name
fields.description: The API name of the custom object (e.g., 'Invoice__c').

fields.name: RecordId
fields.label: Record ID
fields.description: The ID of the custom object record to update.

fields.name: Fields
fields.label: Fields
fields.description: The field-value pairs to update on the custom object.

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.label: Additional Fields
fields.description: Additional properties to include in the request.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response from Salesforce.
